instruction: Ensure the 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' feature in VLC is deactivated to permit opening several videos together.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to disable the one-instance mode (one-instance-when-started-from-file=0 in vlcrc). The evaluator uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric to verify the setting is disabled. Similar complexity to original task - both involve toggling a single VLC preference.
